about.heading: About
paragraphs: Born in 1977. At 21 I took over my family's automotive business and over 25 years built it into a regional mobility and transport company, which I sold in 2023.
What has stayed is an interest in things with substance: vehicles, buildings, businesses. Today I work across four fields.

sections.label: Workshop
sections.heading: Mercedes-Benz, sports cars and classics in good hands.
sections.text: An independent workshop in Zedwitz: maintenance, repair and detailing with a focus on Mercedes-Benz, sports cars and classic cars - right up to full restorations. Plus a towing service that is available around the clock.
sections.imageAlt: Workshop hall with several Mercedes-AMG cars

sections.label: Automobiles
sections.heading: What is a profession in the workshop is a passion here.
sections.text: A private collection of classic Mercedes-Benz, restorations down to the last detail and, now and then, the trade of special vehicles.
sections.imageAlt: Covered car in a dark hall

sections.label: Real Estate
sections.heading: Buying, renovating, building.
sections.text: Commercial properties in Upper Franconia, plus apartments and houses in Austria and Portugal - partly for my own use, partly for rent.
sections.imageAlt: Neoclassical period facade in evening light

sections.label: Facility
sections.heading: Facility management, all year round.
sections.text: Winter service, grounds maintenance and cleaning for commercial properties, residential complexes and property managers in Upper Franconia.
sections.imageAlt: Wheel loader with snow plough on winter service

contact.heading: Contact
contact.text: If any of this is of interest, just get in touch. The quickest way to reach me is by phone or WhatsApp.

datenschutz.heading: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: This website deliberately avoids cookies, tracking, analytics tools and contact forms. No personal data is collected beyond the server log files that are technically unavoidable when the site is accessed.

sections.heading: Hosting and Server Log Files
sections.text: When you visit this website, the hosting provider automatically collects technical information transmitted by your browser. This includes: IP address, date and time of the request, page requested, and the browser and operating system used. These server log files are used solely for the technical security and stability of the site and are not combined with other data sources.

sections.heading: No Cookies, No Tracking
sections.text: This website does not use cookies or any analytics or tracking tools. Your usage behaviour is not evaluated in any way.

sections.heading: Fonts and Images
sections.text: Fonts and images are hosted locally on this website. No connection is made to Google Fonts, image services or any other external provider.

sections.heading: No Forms
sections.text: This website contains no contact forms. Contact is made exclusively through the channels you choose yourself - phone, WhatsApp, email or LinkedIn.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.text: Since no personal data is collected beyond the technically unavoidable server log files, no further rights to access, correction or deletion typically arise from this. If you have any questions about data protection, you can reach me at any time using the contact details listed in the legal notice.
